ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >95% of the surface; high-intensity (white/beige) pixels concentrated at distal tips and sparse isolated points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform black pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast clusters (white/beige) located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes. Minor high-intensity point-source pixels scattered across the left lobe medial region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 45-50 degrees; vertex is sharply defined at the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (scalloping) present along the entire continuous boundary of the trailing edge. Peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a broadly concave trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips, modulated by a repeating series of semi-circular arcs (scallops).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast multi-tonal clusters (beige and white) at the left and right distal tips, indicating substantial localized surface accumulation. A single distinct circular white spot is visible on the upper mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, light-colored linear marks of varying lengths and unaligned orientations visible on the left lobe ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the outer lateral margins of both lobes; one distinct circular white scar (likely a parasitic lesion) on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A sparse distribution of small white spots (speckling) primarily on the left lobe, creating a low-density high-contrast pattern against the black background.
